data.name: ErrMicrophoneFailed
data.value: Microphone recording failed to start. Check your microphone in Settings → {0}.
data.comment: Agent panel error. {0} is where, built from the Settings tab names ("AI Agent → Speech Input (STT)").

data.name: StatusRecording
data.comment: AI Companion panel: status while push-to-talk records.

data.name: StatusTranscribing
data.comment: AI Companion panel: status while what was said is turned into text.

data.name: StatusNoSpeechCaptured
data.value: No speech captured — hold the key while you speak.
data.comment: AI Companion panel: push-to-talk recorded nothing — the key was let go too soon.

data.name: StatusNoSpeechDetected
data.value: No speech detected — try speaking a bit longer.
data.comment: AI Companion panel: push-to-talk recorded sound but no words were recognised.

data.name: ErrTranscriptionFailed
data.comment: AI Companion panel: error when what was said could not be turned into text. {0} is the error.

data.name: ErrNoModel
data.value: No model is set up. Add one, with its key or its server's address, in Settings → {0}.
data.comment: Agent panel error. {0} is where, built from the Settings tab names ("AI Agent → Speech Input (STT)").

data.name: ErrAgentDisabled
data.value: Agent is disabled. Enable it in Settings → {0}.
data.comment: Agent panel error. {0} is where, built from the Settings tab names ("AI Agent → Speech Input (STT)").

data.name: StatusOrganizingContext
data.comment: AI Companion panel: status while the earlier conversation is being summarised before the next answer.

data.name: StatusThinking
data.comment: AI Companion panel: status while waiting for the model's answer.

data.name: StatusLookingIntoIt
data.comment: AI Companion panel: status after the question was handed to the model that reads the user's data.

data.name: ToolStatusQueryDatabase
data.comment: AI Companion panel: status while the agent queries the app's database.

data.name: ToolStatusDescribeTables

data.name: ToolStatusGetCharacterInfo

data.comment: AI Companion panel: status while the agent looks up market prices.

data.name: ToolStatusSearchItems
data.comment: AI Companion panel: status while the agent searches the item list.

data.name: ToolStatusCaptureTab

data.name: ToolStatusManageAlarms

data.name: StatusCopiedRows
data.comment: A grid the agent made, in its own tab: after Copy Selected or Copy All. {0} is the number of rows copied.

data.name: StatusSavedRows
data.comment: A grid the agent made, in its own tab: after Save CSV. {0} is the number of rows, {1} the file's name.

data.name: StatusCopiedDocument
data.comment: A document the agent wrote, in its own tab: after Copy Markdown.

data.name: StatusSavedTo
data.comment: A document the agent wrote, in its own tab: after Save. {0} is the file's name.

data.name: TitleSaveDocument
data.comment: Title of the save dialog for a document the agent wrote. "Save" is a verb.

data.name: FileTypeText
data.comment: Save dialog, file type list: plain text files (*.txt).

data.name: FileTypeAllFiles
data.comment: Save dialog, file type list: any file (*).

data.name: TitleSaveGrid
data.comment: Title of the save dialog for a grid (table) the agent made. "Save" is a verb.

data.name: ErrDocumentRender
data.value: This document could not be rendered: {0}
data.comment: A document the agent wrote, in its own tab: shown above the document's raw text when it cannot be displayed formatted. {0} is the error.

data.name: GridRowsOne
data.comment: A grid the agent made, in its own tab: how many rows it has. {0} is the number (this form: one).

data.name: GridRowsOther
data.comment: A grid the agent made, in its own tab: how many rows it has. {0} is the number.

data.name: ToolCallsNone
data.comment: Line above an agent reply, and AI Usage: the reply called no tools, so it looked nothing up.

data.name: ToolCallsOne
data.comment: Line above an agent reply, and AI Usage. {0} is the number of tool calls (this form: one), {1} the tools' names, which stay as they are ("query_database ×2, show_table").

data.name: ToolCallsOther
data.comment: Line above an agent reply, and AI Usage. {0} is the number of tool calls, {1} the tools' names, which stay as they are ("query_database ×2, show_table").

data.name: MetaAlarm
data.comment: Line above an agent message, where its tool calls would be: the message comes from an alarm.

data.name: MetaVoiceChange
data.comment: Line above an agent message, where its tool calls would be: the message announces that another voice is speaking.

data.name: MetaModelChange
data.comment: Line above an agent message, where its tool calls would be: the message announces that another AI model is answering.
